speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that history; to better understand the underlying cause of your rash and neurological symptoms, have you noticed any specific exposure to plants, chemicals, or new medications recently? Also, have you experienced any difficulty swallowing or breathing?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Heavy Metal Poisoning (likely Arsenic) secondary to agricultural exposure. The combination of a pruritic rash ("itchy palms and soles" variant), peripheral neuropathy (tingling/numbness), and occupation on a rice farm is highly suggestive. I recommend immediate testing for arsenic, mercury, and lead levels in blood and urine. REQUEST TEST: Blood_Arsenic, Blood_Mercury, Blood_Lead, Urine_Arsenic.
